description: This file defines a utility enum 'OpenClawKitResources' for locating and loading resource bundles in a Swift project, with logic to find the bundle in various locations depending on the environment (packaged app, SwiftPM development, etc.). It includes methods to locate the bundle and a helper class for bundle lookup.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used solely for obtaining a reference point for bundle lookup via 'Bundle(for:)'

methods.name: locateBundle
methods.description: Attempts to locate and return the appropriate resource bundle by checking multiple locations.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely
methods.description: Safely attempts to load the module bundle by checking various candidate URLs and paths to avoid fatal errors.
